mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to fetch: keyword search, a category listing, current specials, products by id, any Coles links, the list of departments and categories, the full catalogue from our nightly snapshot (fast; set Max items high, filters apply), or the store directory (address, coordinates, opening hours).

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Used in 'search' mode. Each query is searched separately.

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Used in 'category' mode, e.g. https://www.coles.com.au/browse/dairy-eggs-fridge/milk (or just dairy-eggs-fridge/milk). Tip: run mode 'List categories' to get every category URL.

productIds.title: Product ids
productIds.description: Used in 'products' mode: the number at the end of a product URL, e.g. 8150288.

barcodes.title: Barcodes
barcodes.description: Used in 'barcodes' mode: EAN / GTIN codes, e.g. 9300601186945. Looked up in our Coles database (~91% of products have a barcode); leading zeros don't matter.

urls.title: Coles links
urls.description: Used in 'urls' mode: paste any product, search, category or specials link (or a bare product id). Sort order and the specials filter in a link are kept.

specialsGroups.title: Specials types
specialsGroups.description: Used in 'specials' mode. Empty = all specials. Values: halfprice, multibuy, onlineonly.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum products per query / category / link, per store (after filters). For specials, products and the full catalogue: per run and store (the catalogue has ~25k products). Store directory: number of stores.

storeIds.title: Store ids
storeIds.description: Prices and stock of these Coles stores, each store as its own rows. The id is the number at the end of a store page link, e.g. 313 in coles.com.au/find-stores/coles/wa/karratha-313. Empty = Coles' default online store (the one with price history). Store prices come from our nightly read of every store; a store not read since this week's specials change is fetched live.

postcodes.title: Postcodes
postcodes.description: Australian postcodes (up to 500): every Coles store in each postcode, each as its own rows. A postcode without a Coles gives no rows; the run warnings name its nearest store and distance, so you can add it to Store ids. Store prices come from our nightly read of every store (fetched live when it's older than this week's specials change).

allStores.title: All Coles stores
allStores.description: Run the searches / categories / specials in every Coles store (~878). Combine with a small Max items: it applies per store.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Result order. Relevance, price, unit price and best sellers are applied by Coles before paging; biggest discount re-sorts the collected results by % off (use with specialsOnly and a high Max items). Price sorts skip products that are unavailable (no price).

specialsOnly.title: Specials only
specialsOnly.description: Keep only products currently on special (filtered by Coles, so no pages are wasted).

inStockOnly.title: In stock only
inStockOnly.description: Skip products currently unavailable at the store.

minPrice.title: Min price (AUD)
minPrice.description: Keep only products priced at or above this amount.

maxPrice.title: Max price (AUD)
maxPrice.description: Keep only products priced at or below this amount.

excludeCategories.title: Exclude departments
excludeCategories.description: Departments to leave out, by name or URL slug, e.g. 'liquorland' or 'Pet'. Tobacco is excluded by default (age-restricted); remove it from the list to include it.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Keep only these brands (exact brand name, any case), e.g. 'Coles', 'Arnott's'.

minDiscountPercent.title: Min discount (%)
minDiscountPercent.description: Keep only products at least this much below their was-price, e.g. 50 for half price and better. Multi-buy offers have no was-price and never match.

dietary.title: Dietary
dietary.description: Keep only products whose dietary statement includes ALL of these, e.g. Gluten Free, Vegan, Source of Calcium. Needs product details (see Fetch full details).

excludeAllergens.title: Exclude allergens
excludeAllergens.description: Skip products that contain or may contain any of these, e.g. Peanut, Milk, Gluten. Products without allergen data are skipped too. Needs product details.

maxSugarPer100g.title: Max sugar per 100 g/mL
maxSugarPer100g.description: Keep only products with at most this much sugar per 100 g/mL. Needs product details.

minProteinPer100g.title: Min protein per 100 g/mL
minProteinPer100g.description: Keep only products with at least this much protein per 100 g/mL. Needs product details.

changedSince.title: Price changed since
changedSince.description: Return only products whose price changed since this date/time (e.g. 2026-09-01), or 'last-run' for changes since your previous run with the same input. Default online store only.

includeDisappeared.title: Include disappeared products
includeDisappeared.description: With 'Price changed since' = last-run: also list products your previous run returned that are gone now (delisted or no longer matching), as rows with type 'disappeared'.

priceHistoryDays.title: Price history (days)
priceHistoryDays.description: Add each product's price changes from the last N days (0 = off). Every result always includes previous price, 30-day low, 90-day average and a genuine-discount check.

onlyNew.title: Only new products
onlyNew.description: Only products that appeared at Coles in the last 7 days.

onlyNewSpecials.title: Only new specials
onlyNewSpecials.description: Only products that went on special in the last 7 days (specials change every Wednesday).

fetchFullDetails.title: Fetch full details
fetchFullDetails.description: Adds barcode (GTIN), ingredients, allergens, dietary statement, nutrition panel, country of origin and storage from each product page (1 extra request and a small charge per product). Many products already have them from our database at no extra cost.

maxAgeHours.title: Max cache age (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: We refresh every product nightly (Sydney time). Data older than this, or read before this week's specials change (Wednesday), is fetched live instead. 0 = always fetch live.

includeRaw.title: Include raw payload
includeRaw.description: Add the original Coles payload to each record (every field, including ones we do not map).
